settings.foot: Unreserved shelters and fields are first come, first served. Youth leagues and non-profits pay resident rates.

items.q: How do I reserve a shelter or a field?
items.a: Call the Parks and Recreation office at (555) 014-2200, weekdays 8:00 am to 4:30 pm, or visit the park office at the South Gate. There is no online booking form.

items.q: How far ahead can I book?
items.a: Residents from January 2 for the whole season; non-residents from March 1.
Shelters are covered, so bookings go ahead. Fields closed by the crew for wet ground are refunded or moved.
